decisions: SourceChild is the sole immutable source/effective-text/group authority. None grouping stays independent; no parent, attempt, color, text or provider-ID inference.

Bounded exact source and attempt ledgers are independent of stable UUID5 visible-card identity. Same verified group, genuine speaker epoch/key, frozen style, row preferences and source/target languages gate NEW source append only.
Already-bound source completion, target-language changes, retries and metadata update the source contribution/card representation without another append, latestness change or TTL renewal.

A distinct applied source composes available source/translation rows in one snapshot, advances latestness/card revision and refreshes only its full-card lifetime. Card spatial publication coordinates follow the latest source application; source ordering stays source keyed.

First-readable application, not hidden source receipt or translation attempt creation, starts TTL. Hidden pending entries remain bounded and retain the existing closed-source five-second late-arrival fence. Binding can use only the then-visible compatible card, never expired history.

R4 no-renew applies to legacy finalized SELF/Peer too. Removed completion-triggered four-second SELF floor and generic finalized-content TTL refresh. Active SELF preview progress and active-source slot/admission protection remain.
Removed artificial one-second replacement timer/state; kept protected_rows admission, source-order release, watchdog/output cancellation and existing two-slot selection.
No text deduplicator/filter added. Caption composition never feeds accumulated text back to translation requests, source/context history, OSC/chatbox or prompts.

doc_proposals.proposal: Describe canonical source/attempt/card separation, conservative verified group/key compatibility, first-readable pending application, append-only source-driven latestness/TTL and bounded source retention; remove one-second caption pacing and finalized SELF completion-floor wording.

Use coordinated v16 caption-card contract: stable id/occupant, mutable appearance rank, card_revision; Python-only deadlines and original-expiry reconnect; distinguish deterministic presenter evidence from actual renderer/HMD checks.

User-visible: returning A accumulates/moves newest only within a known compatible visible group; independent cards replace immediately unless protected; late completion/metadata/target changes no longer extend finalized SELF or Peer lifetime.
